description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log utility. It facilitates logging with additional chaining capabilities via the LogNode interface, allowing logs to be forwarded to subsequent nodes.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing LogNode, and supports chaining to destination log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain after this LogWrapper.
